metadata.description: Agent skills for Claude Code, Codex, and other compatible harnesses.

plugins.name: reasoning-semiformally
plugins.description: Apply semi-formal certificate reasoning to code analysis — patch verification, fault localization, patch equivalence. Use when reviewing patches, hunting bugs across scopes, comparing fixes, or when code reasoning requires tracing execution across files/modules.

plugins.name: spec-creator
plugins.description: Create or expand formal design specifications for an app, package, or codebase — numbered, layered, cross-linked markdown that defines what exists in the current branch. Includes development guidelines and design guidelines with greenfield discovery and existing-project adoption. Head of the spec-creator → spec-planner → spec-builder pipeline; its specs feed spec-planner.

plugins.name: spec-planner
plugins.description: Plan the implementation of a specification — decompose a spec into a dependency-ordered graph of reviewable task packages, each with a definition of done and a task-specific semi-formal done certificate. Consumes a spec-creator spec (or any spec); produces a kanban plan folder that spec-builder builds.

plugins.name: jj-workspaces
plugins.description: jj (jujutsu) workspaces skill for Claude Code and Codex — creates isolated workspaces for parallel work and sub-agent driven development, and intercepts git-worktree requests in jj-managed repos.

plugins.name: spec-builder
plugins.description: Implement a spec-planner plan — build each task in an isolated jj/git workspace, gate it through a semi-formal correctness review and a definition-of-done validation, then merge. Self-contained (workspace isolation vendored); parallel by default (max 4 agents) or sequential. Consumes a spec-planner plan folder; produces merged, reviewed, validated code.

plugins.name: security
plugins.description: Security workflows for Claude Code and Codex — repository and diff scans, deep multi-pass scans, threat modelling, validation, attack-path analysis, triage, remediation, and reporting against a sealed scan contract.
